scriptLines:
query: '
SELECT a.*
FROM bronze.admissions a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.patients p
    WHERE p.patient_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.patient_id)
)
AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), '') IS NOT NULL
',

department =  case(     in(['cardio', 'cardiolgy', 'cardiology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Cardiology',     in(['onco', 'oncology', 'oncologyy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Oncology',     in(['neuro', 'neurology', 'nuerology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Neurology',     in(['emergancy', 'emergency', 'er'], lower(trim(department))), 'Emergency',     in(['gen surg', 'general surgery', 'generalsurgery'], lower(trim(department))), 'General Surgery',     in(['ortho', 'orthopaedics', 'orthopedics'], lower(trim(department))), 'Orthopedics',     in(['paediatrics', 'pediatrics', 'peds'], lower(trim(department))), 'Pediatrics',     trim(department) )) ~> DRVAdmissions
